subject: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@clearmap.io>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearmap.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold

Hi Ellie / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together an initial renewal package that reflects Clearmap's planned workload growth and the timing constraints you shared. High level: an 18-month renewal (Sep 1, 2027 - Feb 28, 2029) with a 20% uplift in committed units starting month 4, a 30% one-time onboarding credit for the additional seats, and a 6-month interim price-hold on the current rate for existing committed units while we migrate the new pipelines.

Key bullets (detailed proposal attached):
- Term: 18 months; start 2027-09-01
- Commit baseline: Current commit rolled forward; uplift +20% from month 4
- Credits: One-time clearmap seat onboarding credit = $45,000 applied against first invoice after uplift
- Price-hold: 6-month price-hold on existing committed unit price for legacy usage only; new uplifted units billed at negotiated uplift rate
- Ops: Redwood will guarantee capacity floor during month-4 uplift window; David is copied to confirm infra readiness and migration support SLA

I attached a short proposal and your Q2 usage export so you can validate the uplift sizing. If this direction looks good, we can route a clean amendment and Marissa can confirm discount approvals on our side.

Next step ask: Can you confirm whether the uplift is intended for embedded inference only or applies to both embeddings + text-gen workloads? That will change the recommended commit mix.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[attachment: Usage_Report_Q2_2027.csv (csv, 75KB)]
From: Ellie Park <ellie@clearmap.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearmap.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold

Thanks, Priyom —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Quick answers: the uplift applies to both embeddings and text-gen; roughly 60/40 embeddings to text-gen. The onboarding credit sounds reasonable. Two follow-ups from our side: 1) Would Redwood consider a 9-month price-hold instead of 6 months if we commit to a firm multi-cloud deployment (we want the option to route to another region after month 9)? 2) We need confirmation that the credit can be applied pro-rata if we shift the uplift start date by up to 45 days.

Also copying our procurement lead, Tom, in case he wants to sync on contracting timelines.

Ellie
Ellie Park
Head of ML Platform | Clearmap Analytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@clearmap.io>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearmap.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold

Ellie —

Thanks for the clarifications. Short answers below; threading Marissa for the discount/term approval and David for capacity confirmation.

1) 9-month price-hold: We can consider extending to 9 months if Clearmap signs a firm multi-cloud addendum and commits to the uplift baseline (the +20%) by Sep 15. I flagged this as a conditional approval that Marissa needs to sign off on.

2) Pro-rata credit: Yes — we can pro-rate the onboarding credit if the uplift start shifts within a 45-day window. We'll document the exact proration formula in the amendment.

Marissa — can you confirm whether finance/legal are comfortable with the 9-month conditional price-hold if we require the multi-cloud addendum and an execution-by date? If yes, we'll prepare an amendment and a DocuSign packet.

David — please confirm infra ops can guarantee the capacity floor for month-4 uplift (we may need to pre-warm a modest burst pool) and estimate SRE hours required for the migration support window.

Thanks all,
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold

Priyom / David —

I reviewed the ask with finance and legal. We can approve a 9-month price-hold on the legacy committed units under the following conditions:
- Clearmap signs the multi-cloud addendum and the amendment by Sep 15, 2027 (execution-by date)
- Uplift baseline (+20%) must be accepted in writing in the amendment; no retroactive reductions after execution
- Onboarding credit pro-ration formula: credit * (days_active_after_uplift / 45) if uplift delayed up to 45 days

We will need to include a clause limiting the price-hold benefit to existing committed unit quantities only (not applicable to any future add-on commits beyond the uplift). Also, legal asks that we include an audit right for usage mapping in month-1 after uplift to validate billing mix (embeddings vs text-gen).

With those terms, I approve going to DocuSign. Priyom, please include a specific paragraph for the audit right and pro-rata formula in the amendment text.

-Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ellie Park <ellie@clearmap.io>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearmap.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: 18-month renewal + seat uplift with interim price-hold

Hi all —

Ops confirmation: We can provision the pre-warm burst pool and guarantee the capacity floor for the uplift window. Expect a short maintenance/hand-off runbook and ~12 SRE hours for the ramp (we'll include a small one-time professional services fee in the amendment to cover the extra work; estimate $7,500).

Ellie / Tom — happy to schedule a 30-min run-through of the migration plan with your infra team next week. Once you confirm acceptance of the terms Marissa outlined, Priyom can send the DocuSign packet and we'll book the SRE slot.

-David
David Kim
Director, Site Reliability | Redwood Inference
